conviction_note: Q3 is new, so the move is sized near the base for new numbers (6%). The direction is close to a coin flip: management set its 2026 TMT EBITDA estimate of PLN 2.9bn on 28 Oct, after Q3 had closed, and the PAP consensus (adj. EBITDA PLN 810m) was formed after that. A big miss is therefore unlikely, but a beat is too, and the stock has de-rated 29% with brokers saying a rally will not last. Hence p_up 53, scaled number +0.36 against a findings sum of +0.1; the two agree in sign and are both near zero.

already_public.what: Strategy 2027-2030+ adopted: estimated 2026 TMT EBITDA PLN 2.9bn, TMT EBITDA down 2-3% a year to 2029, net debt/EBITDA below 2.5x by 2030, dividend potential restored only by 2030. Shares fell 17.7% on 29 Oct and 12.8% on 30 Oct.
The 2026 group guide of single-digit adjusted EBITDA growth was kept at H1. Renewables EBITDA for 2026 was cut to about PLN 350m. TV ad market for 2026 guided flat.

Board resolved to analyse refinancing the SFA (PLN 8.255bn + EUR 506m, maturing 2028) and series D/E/F bonds (PLN 3.89bn, maturing 2030), with Pekao IB as adviser. The analysis is described as preliminary.
Q3 2026 broker median: revenue PLN 3.61bn, adjusted EBITDA PLN 810m (+5.7% y/y), EBIT PLN 390m, net profit PLN 105m.
EGM called for 14 Dec 2026 at the request of Reddev (28.05%), with supervisory board changes and an Articles amendment on the agenda.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 adjusted EBITDA close to the PLN 810m median, perhaps slightly above, because management knew Q3 when it set the 2.9bn TMT estimate. Within that, Q3 telecom/media carries the salary-provision cost now spread across the year, and Q4 takes the relief.

2.9bn TMT / single-digit group EBITDA growth most likely reiterated. The TV ad market assumption ('flat') is at risk of a cut. Renewables are already cut. A large change is unlikely three weeks after the strategy.
Unknown. FY guide is 'high hundreds of millions' adjusted FCF after interest; LTM was PLN 981m at Q2. Covenant net debt/EBITDA was 3.63x at Q2.

A possible update on refinancing timing or terms and on the asset-sale process (PAK-PCE, Port Praski) on the 19 Nov call. Unknown which way. BDM names a strategy 'addendum' as the only real upside catalyst.
None expected. The strategy defers dividends to about 2030.

findings.finding: Management set its 2026 TMT EBITDA estimate of PLN 2.9bn on 28 Oct, after Q3 had closed. With H1 TMT adjusted EBITDA at PLN 1,516m (B2C/B2B 621.9+616.6, media 119.7+158.2), that implies H2 TMT of about PLN 1,384m, +5% y/y on H2 2025 (1,318m). So Q3 lands inside a number management already gave. The salary-provision change ('more even distribution ... eliminating their concentration in Q4') puts extra cost into Q3 and relief into Q4, so Q3 y/y growth may sit below the H2 average.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 missed consensus (net about 34% below) and the stock fell at the next open, about -7% on the estimated date. Q2 2026 beat consensus by 0.4% on EBITDA and 8% on net profit, and the session was volatile and mixed (17.2 to just under 16 zł).
findings.why_not_priced: The strategy release gave the 2.9bn figure but never set it against H1 segment EBITDA, and the press coverage (xyz.pl, Parkiet) compares it with nothing. If the market had read it as setting a floor for Q3, the 810m consensus formed on 12 Nov would equal the guide-implied run rate, and it roughly does. So this is mostly priced, and the finding sits near zero.
findings.independence: Strategy current report 17/2026 gives the 2.9bn (https://grupapolsatplus.pl/en/archive/adoption-polsat-plus-groups-strategy-2027-2030). The Q2 briefing gives the salary-provision change (https://grupapolsatplus.pl/sites/default/files/documents/2026/brief_gpp_q2_26_eng_f_0.pdf). Both are company documents.

findings.finding: Orange Polska's Q3 2026 showed a strong Polish telecom market: revenue +7.9%, EBITDAaL +15.6% to PLN 1.039bn, 82k net contract voice adds. The pricing environment is healthy, but the incumbent is also taking contract customers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No CPS reaction to a peer read-through is on record. Analysts already expect CPS telecom to trail Orange in 2027-28 (xyz.pl, 30 Oct).
findings.source_date: 2026-10 (Orange Q3 2026 release; date in URL is the period, not verified to the day)
findings.original_quote: Przychody zwiększyły się o 7,9%, a wskaźnik EBITDAaL o 15,6%
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer, not a counterparty, and it was public before the 810m consensus was formed. It is a proxy, so it is small. If the market had read it as a CPS positive, the stock would not have drifted lower after 13 Nov (13.25 to 12.83 zł).
findings.independence: https://comparic.pl/akcje-orange-polska-wystrzelily-o-57-zysk-w-iii-kw-rosnie-o-44/ (same release, different outlet; not independent evidence about CPS)

findings.finding: The TV advertising market is weaker than Polsat's August 'flat' assumption. Kino Polska puts H1 2026 TV ad spend at -2.4% with further declines expected in H2. Parkiet's 12 Nov preview says broadcasters' ad revenue fell again in Q3. Polsat's own Q2 ad revenue was -4.1%. That makes a cut to the market assumption in the release more likely, landing on media, about 20% of TMT EBITDA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q3 2025 a 'surprisingly weak' TV ad line was one of BDM's negatives on a print the stock fell after. Q2 2026's flat-market revision did not stop media EBITDA rising 12%.
findings.original_quote: Spadki wpływów z reklam kolejny kwartał z rzędu zanotować miały stacje telewizyjne
findings.why_not_priced: It is an industry proxy that analysts already discuss, so most of it sits in the 810m median. The unpriced part is only whether management lowers its own 'flat' market assumption. Q3 2025 media EBITDA was a low base (PLN 69.4m), which limits the downside on the quarter itself.
findings.independence: Kino Polska management: H1 -2.4% and further declines expected in H2 (https://comparic.pl/kino-polska-ostrzega-przed-spadkiem-rynku-reklamy-tv-prognozy-pierwszy-raz-od-lat-negatywne/). Polsat Q2 briefing: 'we expect the market to remain flat YoY' (https://grupapolsatplus.pl/sites/default/files/documents/2026/brief_gpp_q2_26_eng_f_0.pdf).

findings.finding: Since 4 Nov the board has been analysing a refinancing of about PLN 14bn of debt (SFA maturing April 2028 plus bonds maturing 2030) with Pekao IB as adviser. The money buys maturity extension and possibly lower cost, not a ramp. PKO BP's analyst reads the tighter 2.5x dividend condition as reflecting what the banks expect. The release and call may give a first update.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nothing comparable on record for this name. On 4 Nov, the announcement day, the stock rose 2.8%, attributed by BDM to a rebound and green-energy sentiment.
findings.why_not_priced: The company called the analysis preliminary and gave no terms, so the price holds only the fact that it exists. A concrete timetable or pricing on the call would be new. The sign is mildly positive because it removes the 2028 maturity wall, but the company may say nothing.
findings.independence: GlobalCapital headline 'Polsat to start refinancing $4.7bn of loans and bonds' (https://www.globalcapital.com/article/28mssyp51jgqspw9ceo05/syndicated-loans/emerging-market-loans/polsat-to-start-refinancing-4-7bn-of-loans-and-bonds), undated, headline only.

findings.finding: Sentiment is washed out going into the print. The stock lost about 29% in two sessions on 10x normal volume after the strategy. PKO BP cut to sell (target 13.7 zł) and Wood holds sell (11.9 zł), while the Bloomberg average target was 16.55 zł. Brokers say no significant, lasting positive reaction should be expected, and BDM names a strategy 'addendum' as the one catalyst for a rebound.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Before the Q3 2025 print the stock had already fallen nearly 20%. Erste expected a neutral reaction because the weakness was 'largely priced', and the stock still fell at the open.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: this is the 20-day run-up, which is also the free control and the lean. Kept small because positioning is the thing to beat, not to agree with. The only part that is not the run-up is the dispersion between the sell targets and the Bloomberg average.

baseline_tension: Roughly neutral against the lean. The lean is the -26.7% run-up read as mean-reversion (+1.33), and the washed-out-sentiment finding agrees with it but is small. The quarter itself lands inside a guide management gave after Q3 had closed, so the evidence neither confirms nor contradicts the run-up.
language_note: The Q3 consensus (PLN 810m adj. EBITDA, 105m net) and brokers' expectations for the reaction appeared only in Parkiet's Polish preview of 12 Nov. No English source carried them.
Session evidence (results 'after Wednesday's close', reaction at Thursday's open) came from Polish press. The issuer's timestamp came from a Polish-hosted ESPI attachment filename.
Analyst reactions to the strategy (PKO BP downgrade, Wood sell, BDM on the 2.5x dividend condition, UNIQA TFI calling the guide well below consensus) appeared only in Polish (Parkiet, xyz.pl).
The asset-sale advisers (UniCredit, Erste) and the 2028-29 timeline appeared only in Polish (money.pl citing a Czech portal).
The company's English IR pages carried every primary document (strategy, refinancing, EGM, Q2 workbook) as fully as the Polish ones.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Q3-inside-2.9bn finding moved from -0.3 to -0.1.

'Size the move on what is new; you were too small by a factor of about three': abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 6.0, because Q3 numbers are new even though the FY guide is fresh. Not raised to 7-9, since a guidance change is unlikely three weeks after the strategy.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series' / proxy weight: the Orange peer read-through cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not to agree with': the washed-out-sentiment finding, which agrees with the run-up lean, cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
Session lesson: session_check opens with 'amc' and cites the issuer timestamp URL.
